snippet.title: Goodly Trials Gameplay Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
I'm excited to share a game I have been working on:

Goodly Trials is a turn-based strategy game blending roguelike and auto-battler mechanics.
+ Single-player: Ranked and Casual
+ Multiplayer: Real-time and Asynchronous

Early Access starts in August 2026.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4985160/Goodly_Trials
